items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 81:1
items.html: The essence of Arich Anpin is two heads — the Galgalta and the Sealed Brain — and they are included one in the other, as is known. Thus the Galgalta is included of two heads: Keter and the sealed Hochma; and likewise the Sealed Brain is included of two heads: Keter and the Sealed Brain. And it is known that the illumination of the Sealed Brain cannot be revealed in the head itself; hence the illumination of its two heads is revealed in the beard. Now, according to this, there should be in the beard two times ten Sefirot — the ten Sefirot of Keter and the ten Sefirot of Hochma. However, since the hairs of the beard came out of the aspect of the head, they could receive only the HET from the aspect of Keter, which are from Gevura and below, and the nine from the aspect of Hochma, which are from Bina and below, as written on Page 393, s.v. 'behold.' See there. (Page 391, Item 196).
